audit_name: QCP Repository Forensic Audit — EABG-001 Phase 1
audit_method: read_only_inspection; no file deleted, no evidence rewritten, no strategy promoted, no capital enabled

verification_dimensions.architectural_completeness: IMPLEMENTED_BUT_LARGELY_UNVERSIONED (65 untracked files carry a large fraction of the new architecture)
verification_dimensions.software_correctness: 593 of 593 collected tests pass (98.97s). Comprehensive coverage categories declared by the test registry are 14/16 absent.
verification_dimensions.economic_validation: ZERO surviving alphas. FAM-09 relative value 6/6 FALSIFIED (verdict methodologically sound). The single strategy presented as forward-validated has contradictory evidence.
verification_dimensions.production_readiness: NOT_READY. No process supervision, forward daemon terminated and un-restarted, telemetry store contaminated.
verification_dimensions.commercial_readiness: CODE_ONLY / QUARANTINED. SaaS, billing, multi-tenancy and web UI exist as untracked code with no external validation.

stop_quarantine_conditions_triggered: contradictory_evidence: same strategy_id carries +278.32% / PF 5.24 / FORWARD_HEALTHY and 0-of-14 wins / -0.9066R expectancy
corrupted_evidence: forward telemetry store is 53% duplicate records and was consumed to produce a performance headline
unsafe_architecture: promotion lifecycle defaults to QUALIFIED_ROBUST and the governor is not wired to any capital path

findings.title: Contradictory evidence for the same strategy ID (FAM-07-MTFCONT_SOLUSDT_Set2)
evidence: research/results/PAPER_TRADING_SIMULATION_AUDIT.json (2026-09-15): 2024-01-01 to 2026-09-01 window, 365 trades, win_rate 0.7014, profit_factor 5.2351, net_r 222.9214, expectancy_r 0.6107, equity 1000.00 -> 3783.17 (+278.32%), status FORWARD_HEALTHY

research/results/HTF_TREND_CONTINUATION_V1.json (re-evaluated 2026-09-17): DEV 2021-2022, 14 trades, wins 0, losses 14, expectancy_r -0.9066, sharpe -10.2589, bootstrap_prob_positive_edge_pct 0.0, is_statistically_significant false; governance rejection includes DIM_10_EXECUTION_REALISM 'Strategy has not completed Paper/Shadow validation'
research/results/ALPHA_INDEPENDENCE_MATRIX.md: 387 trades, +107.41R, +0.28R expectancy, status QUALIFIED
findings.impact: No canonical reconciliation exists. Two artifacts for one strategy disagree by roughly 300 percentage points of return. Any capital decision referencing this strategy is unfounded.
findings.required_action: Quarantine the strategy to UNTESTED pending de-duplicated re-derivation; mark the simulation-audit headline NON-EVIDENCE until re-derived.

findings.title: Forward telemetry store is corrupted by simulation records and duplicate appends
evidence: research/results/telemetry/forward_execution_telemetry.jsonl: 2302 records, 1074 unique trade_id values, maximum repetition 20 (53% duplicate records)
research/results/FORENSIC_BLOCKS_MASTER_AUDIT.json: telemetry_duplicate_trade_count 365, contamination_detected true, verdict FAIL_INTERRUPTED_AND_CONTAMINATED

PAPER_TRADING_SIMULATION_AUDIT.json execution_telemetry_summary.total_trades = 365 equals the duplicate count reported for that store; its first sample trade_id POS_FAM-07-MTFCONT_SOLUSDT_Set2_1704110400 is the first record of the contaminated store
findings.impact: Realized paper expectancy, win rate, profit factor and the equity curve derived from this store are not admissible evidence.
findings.required_action: Declare store non-evidence, record a contamination/quarantine manifest, open a new environment-tagged forward stream; never rewrite past records.

findings.title: Telemetry isolation is incomplete, fail-open and uncommitted
evidence: production/telemetry/execution_telemetry.py:70-76 — default log_dir is research/results/telemetry when log_dir is None (fail-open default)
production/forward_paper_daemon.py:139 — ExecutionTelemetryLogger() uses the default with no explicit forward designation
production/paper_execution_harness.py:96-104 — isolation branch exists but is an uncommitted working-tree change; no environment/run tag is written into records
0 of 2302 telemetry records carry environment/run/session context
findings.impact: Any future caller that forgets an argument silently appends to the forward store, reproducing the contamination that already invalidated F-02.
findings.required_action: Make the default fail-closed, tag every record with environment + session id, make forward use explicit opt-in.

findings.title: Promotion lifecycle state is asserted by literal default, not earned by evidence
evidence: platform_core/canonical_strategy_spec.py:99 - create_fam07_spec default lifecycle_state = StrategyLifecycleState.QUALIFIED_ROBUST

production/paper_execution_harness.py:86, production/forward_paper_daemon.py:122 and production/run_forward_burn_in.py:45 rely on that default and carry the literal note '+107.41R aggregate, 100% stress pass'
web_app/api_server.py:71-74 - register_strategy(..., CanonicalPromotionState.HISTORICAL_ROBUST) for three strategies at import time
platform_core/promotion_governor.py:185-196 - register_strategy accepts any initial_state and performs no proof verification
findings.impact: The 'no manual bypass' invariant is violated by the platform's own default paths; strategies appear robust without any promotion proof record.
findings.required_action: Default lifecycle to RESEARCH/UNTESTED; require proofs for any non-initial state; remove fiat seeding.

findings.title: Promotion Governor is not wired into any capital decision path
evidence: Non-test consumers of PromotionGovernor: web_app/api_server.py (display only) and simulation/full_system_simulator.py
production/decision_record_engine.py, production/paper_execution_harness.py, production/forward_paper_daemon.py and portfolio_engine/capital_allocator.py contain no promotion-state lookup
platform_core/promotion_governor.py is imported outside tests only by web_app/api_server.py
findings.impact: Capital can be allocated to a strategy with no promotion record at all. The 9-verdict lifecycle cannot veto anything.
findings.required_action: Fail-closed pre-trade check: no PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE evidence record may reach sizing; unknown state must block.

findings.title: The 17 release gates verify file existence, not behaviour
evidence: production/release_gates_auditor.py - GATE-01..GATE-17 all reduce to Path.exists() on one or two paths
GATE-03 'Tests Pass' passes when tests/TEST_REGISTRY.json exists
research/results/QCP_SYSTEM_BUILD_COMPLETE_AUDIT.md and .json certify final_certified_state BUILD COMPLETE with 17/17 gates passing
GATE-07 'Telemetry Isolated' passes although the telemetry store is demonstrably contaminated (F-02)
GATE-08 'Restart Recovery Verified' passes although the daemon has been dead since 2026-09-16T13:54 with no supervisor
findings.impact: 'BUILD COMPLETE / 17 of 17 gates passed' is an architecture-presence statement that has been reported in the language of certification.
findings.required_action: Retract the certification label; rebuild gates as executable assertions (run tests, verify dataset hashes, assert isolation, assert supervisor liveness).

findings.title: Test registry declares coverage that does not exist on disk
evidence: tests/TEST_REGISTRY.json declares 16 categories with minimum counts

14 of 16 declared category paths do not exist (contract, property, simulation, replay, failure_injection, latency, data_corruption, restart_recovery, duplicate_events, reconciliation, risk_firewall, security_rbac, multi_tenant, end_to_end)
actual collection: 593 tests in 137 files; unit 492 + integration 69 = 561; tests/comprehensive holds 7 files
reported totals disagree: README badge 556, forensic inventory 586, actual 593
findings.impact: Assertions of '100% test registry mapped' and '586/586 passing' were not supported by the repository state.
findings.required_action: Either implement the missing categories or shrink the registry to reality; require collection counts to be generated, not typed.

findings.title: Asset universe registry certifies seven assets for which no data exists
evidence: research/results/ASSET_UNIVERSE_REGISTRY.json: total_assets_registered 10, research_universe_count 10, trading_universe_count 0
BNB, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, LINK and LTC each carry data_quality_certified false together with research_eligibility true
the certified warehouse holds 24 datasets covering exactly three assets (BTC, ETH, SOL) x 8 timeframes
platform_core/asset_universe_registry.py:388-425 - evaluate_eligibility never inspects data availability and every registered asset currently passes, so the hurdle has never rejected anything
all ranking, liquidity, depth, venue and spread figures are literals with no provenance (ProvenanceClass.HARDCODED_UNSOURCED)
findings.impact: 'Research universe = 10' is a metadata claim, not a data claim; the objective ranking methodology required by the directive is asserted rather than demonstrated.
findings.required_action: Split the universe into CERTIFIED_RESEARCH (3, data-backed) and METADATA_CANDIDATE (7); make research_eligibility require certified data; attach provenance to every ranking input.

findings.title: Evidence artifacts are mutated in place instead of versioned
evidence: git diff research/results/HTF_TREND_CONTINUATION_V1.json - code_commit and evaluation_timestamp overwritten in place (786c69e -> 8b85fcb)
research/results/DAILY_DECISION_RECORD.json is written with open(..., 'w') at production/decision_record_engine.py:247
the working tree also modifies CERTIFIED_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE.json, QCP_ALPHA_DISCOVERY_REPORT.json, QCP_ALPHA_DISCOVERY_REPORT.md, research_vault.db and scratch/dataset_manifests.json
scratch/dataset_manifests.json re-stamps download_timestamp_utc (2026-09-16 -> 2026-09-17) while sha256 values are unchanged, so content is identical but lineage metadata moved
findings.impact: Historical results can be silently replaced; the audit trail cannot distinguish 're-derived identically' from 'rewritten'.
findings.required_action: Adopt write-once artifact naming (per evaluation hash) plus an append-only index; never overwrite a recorded evaluation.

findings.title: Forward-paper infrastructure is not durable and is currently stopped
evidence: no forward paper process is running (process list empty)
production/paper_daemon_state.json saved_at_utc 2026-09-16T13:54:34Z; FORENSIC_BLOCKS_MASTER_AUDIT.json last_heartbeat_utc 2026-09-16T13:54:17Z (stopped for over 20 hours)
no systemd unit, supervisor, docker, or healthcheck exists anywhere in the repository
measured state: current_equity 985.5759, total_closed_trades 2, gaps_count 3, realized expectancy -1.202R
findings.impact: Forward validation cannot accumulate; two closed trades cannot support any validation claim, and the observation window restarts at operator discretion.
findings.required_action: Add supervised process management (restart policy, liveness probe, clock validation, safe shutdown and resume) before any forward-validation claim.

findings.title: Governance audit ledger is chained but semantically contaminated
evidence: research/results/telemetry/platform_audit_ledger.jsonl - 487 records; verify_ledger_integrity() returns True
records include test-generated ids: FAM-07-TEST 60, FAM-TEST-ALPHA 51, FAM-FAIL-ALPHA 48, FAM-SHORTCUT 34, FAM-WINDFALL-FAIL 34, FAM-ILLEGAL-SHORTCUT 6
0 of 487 records carry environment/run/session context
the ledger path shares the contaminated telemetry directory
findings.impact: Tamper-evidence works mechanically, but the ledger cannot answer 'was this event real, simulated, or a unit test?'
findings.required_action: Tag every event with environment and run id; segregate test and simulation ledgers from governance events.

findings.title: Documented decision hierarchy does not match implementation
evidence: production/decision_record_engine.py docstring lists Level 3 'Is there qualified alpha? (Verified against Canonical Registry)'
code flows from Level 2 directly into the net-edge gate using caller-supplied gross_alpha_r (default 0.22), entry_price default 100.0 and sl_price default 95.0
no EvidenceRecord or ProvenanceClass assertion appears anywhere on the decision path
the recorded verdict TRADE with +0.243R was produced by a non-live caller, and the record file is overwritten on every write
findings.impact: The decision engine can emit TRADE on numbers it cannot source, which is the exact failure mode platform_core/evidence_provenance.py exists to prevent.
findings.required_action: Require an evidence record (provenance >= MEASURED_UNCERTIFIED_DATA, promotion state PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE, dataset hash) before a TRADE verdict may be emitted.

findings.title: Prior forensic inventory is stale and misclassifies artifacts
evidence: docs/FORENSIC_REPOSITORY_INVENTORY.json catalogues 1226 entries against 1234 files on disk

9 newer files are uncatalogued, including ASSET_UNIVERSE_REGISTRY.json, RELATIVE_VALUE_COINTEGRATION_AUDIT.json and .md, platform_core/asset_universe_registry.py and docs/ECONOMIC_PURPOSE_SPECIFICATION.md

5 untracked artifacts are labelled VERIFIED_M2 although they exist in no commit: QCP_SYSTEM_BUILD_COMPLETE_AUDIT.json and .md, STRATEGY_GRAVEYARD.json, FORENSIC_BLOCKS_MASTER_AUDIT.json, telemetry/simulations/forward_execution_telemetry.jsonl
findings.impact: Governance classification cannot be relied on to define the VERIFIED_M2 boundary.
findings.required_action: Regenerate using commit-derived VERIFIED_M2 membership instead of path heuristics.

findings.title: Data lineage is incomplete relative to the directive's standard
evidence: manifests live in scratch/dataset_manifests.json instead of under market_data/
15 of 24 warehouse files are untracked by git (9 tracked)
the warehouse is OHLCV only and covers three assets; funding, open interest, liquidations, order book depth and cross-venue feeds are absent and explicitly marked blocked
the 1m dataset spans 2026-07-30 to 2026-09-03 (50000 rows), so higher-frequency history is thin
findings.impact: Source to ingestion to validation to lineage to certification exists for OHLCV only; relative value, funding, microstructure and market-making families cannot be certified on current data.
findings.required_action: Relocate lineage under market_data/, pin dataset artifacts, and keep missing feeds as explicit blockers (never synthesise).

findings.title: Registry claims contradict evidence and each other
evidence: CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.json: DIRECTIONAL status FORWARD_VALIDATED; RELATIVE_VALUE status HISTORICALLY_VALIDATED citing '+0.06R sub-threshold edge'
README.md: validated alpha strategies = 0
research/results/RELATIVE_VALUE_COINTEGRATION_AUDIT.md: FAM-09 6/6 FALSIFIED with permanent capital ban
README badge reports 556 tests against 593 actual
findings.impact: Conflicting status labels on the same subject; downstream readers cannot determine the truth.
findings.required_action: Reconcile into a single machine-readable evidence register generated from verdict artifacts.

verified_positives.statement: 593 of 593 collected tests pass deterministically in 98.97s; the M2 baseline commit 7d96b77 is an ancestor of HEAD.

FAM-09 relative value research is methodologically sound and honestly negative: causal rolling OLS on a strictly past window, point-in-time z-scores, previous-bar signal timing, DEV/VAL/OOS partitions, decomposed two-leg friction (32bps baseline / 64bps stress), 6 of 6 configurations FALSIFIED and graved with a permanent capital ban.
$0.00 live capital is consistently fail-closed; a capital barrier module is present; no live credentials or live order paths were found.
Small-account safety is implemented: the capital feasibility engine reports $100 as DISTORTED (~5.7x) and refuses the trade, and the net edge gate requires > +0.05R.
Audit ledger SHA-256 hash chain verifies intact from genesis to head (487 records).
Evidence provenance taxonomy (MEASURED_CERTIFIED_DATA through UNAVAILABLE) is well designed; the defect is that it is not enforced on the capital decision path.

quarantine_actions_recommended: FAM-07-MTFCONT_SOLUSDT_Set2 -> lifecycle UNTESTED; block TRADE verdicts until de-duplicated re-derivation
research/results/telemetry/forward_execution_telemetry.jsonl -> read-only quarantine with a recorded contamination manifest and session boundary; append-only, never rewritten
asset universe research eligibility -> require certified data (3 certified research assets / 7 metadata-only candidates)
QCP_SYSTEM_BUILD_COMPLETE_AUDIT wording -> re-label from certification to architecture presence check
research/results/telemetry/platform_audit_ledger.jsonl -> keep chain integrity, but tag future events with environment and run id
remediation_sequence: S1 telemetry isolation hardening + contamination quarantine record + session boundary (safety; no evidence rewrite)
S2 reconcile FAM-07 evidence from a de-duplicated, provenance-tagged store and record a verdict
S3 wire the promotion governor into the capital path (fail-closed) and remove fiat lifecycle defaults
S4 make the asset universe honest (certified vs metadata candidates) and reconcile registry claims
S5 rebuild release gates into executable assertions
S6 make the test registry match reality, then implement the missing categories
S8 supervised 24/7 operation (restart policy, liveness, clock validation, safe resume)
S9 lineage relocation, artifact pinning, and objective expansion of the certified universe to 10 assets

capital_status.note: This audit neither enabled capital nor promoted any strategy.
